set.body:
Outcome: controlled concrete ONNX registration derives one immutable factorized channel, nominations and LocalEvidence from actual recorded attempts, with exact replay.
Scope: align portable checked rendering context, factorized declared vectors/closed shared evaluator and nomination/pricing dispatch; embed-onnx actual executed envelope; portable align->embedCore and embedOnnx->align.jvm build edges; ADR0019/workflows/evidence. Parent G1 remains open for historical video/preset weighted-cost parity and StageTrace adoption. Synthetic existing 4D ONNX fixture only, no model acquisition/private data/efficacy claims.
Invariants: library uses complete declared checked recall/source-node inventory, never caller-selected coordinate pairs. Store endpoint embeddings O((U+N)d), compute pair scores on demand; no all-pairs table/cache. Bind exact texts/representation/policy plus recall/view and complete population. Scorer keys canonical endpoint content+exact text, coordinates only orchestration. Shared closed dispatch for nomination and pricing; context-free APIs refuse this channel. Public portable vectors are declared data, never executed authority. Only concrete adapter mints JVM envelope; it builds requests, calls record and derives all outputs. No attach-receipts/evidence factory or generic callback. Validate query/document geometries, all outcome IDs/spaces/dimensions and conflicting equal endpoint keys. Require explicit sensitivity; no plain private input/vector digest. Half cosine only for current strict pricing; raw-vs-half parity is separate. Preserve exact typed failures both endpoints, using a fixed namespaced coarse engine reason rather than ProviderAbstained. Explicit empty-text policy and no attempted receipt for skipped inputs; refuse empty population before execution.
Relevant paths: align content.scala/surfacerender.scala/strictcost.scala/candidatepolicy.scala/evidence.scala; embed-onnx OnnxSentenceEmbedder.scala; embed-core identity/contract/vector; build.sbt; ADR0019.
Proposed change: expert-approved portable declared factorized channel and context, JVM-only non-case executed envelope derived from real RecordedBatch values. Add outside-consumer failing witnesses before bridge implementation.
Acceptance: text/context/population/geometry and channel substitution, both-endpoint denial/failure, missing/ineligible, empty input policy, declared data cannot mint executed envelope, exact replay after close/no calls, ID/storage permutation laws, exact nomination/pricing values. Compile courts and named compiled mutations; serial fatal-warning reference-scope and consumer gates, formatting last, exact-SHA independent review, checked receipts and narrow commits.
Risks: preserve existing lexical/content-table/historical APIs and identities; no policy laundering of source admission or arbitrary selections; no dense pair allocation or compiler privacy scope shortcut. Full retained endpoint failures and execution identity remain separate from LocalEvidence numerical identity.
Next action: finalize empty/failure policy with reviewer, reserve paths and amend ADR; implement portable contract/failing JVM consumer witness then concrete bridge and qualification.
set.title: [G1/S2b-3] Register concrete ONNX mapping execution over bound surface inventory
